meta.name: Special Ops 1 5 The Himmat Story 1080p
meta.description: After the 2001 Indian Parliament attack, a young and idealistic R&AW officer had a theory. In 2003, he had a mystery. This is the story of Himmat Singh.

videos.title: Aandhi
videos.overview: Abbas Sheikh is summoned by auditors to evaluate Himmat Singh’s career as his retirement draws near. A young field agent Himmat's story unveils post-2001 Parliament attack.

videos.title: Mere Apne
videos.overview: As some of India’s top officials are honey-trapped, R&AW realises top-secret data is compromised. While Himmat and Vijay narrow the suspects, an ex-R&AW officer is on the run.

videos.title: Lekin
videos.overview: A cat-and-mouse chase begins between Maninder, Himmat and Vijay to recover top-secret national data. However, Himmat is in for a surprise.

videos.title: Ijazat
videos.overview: Moments before the data reaches the highest bidder, Himmat faces the test of his life. Abbas’s inquiry ends with his report on Himmat Singh. Are the auditors convinced?
